title: Spinach & Cottage Cheese Stuffed Chicken Breast with Sweet Potatoes & Endives
originalTitle: Sweet potato with chicken breast stuffed with spinach and cottage cheese. Endives
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (6 oz each)
2 cups fresh baby spinach, wilted and finely chopped
2 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese + 2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp smoked paprika, salt & black pepper
2 medium sweet potatoes, cubed or halved and roasted at 400°F
3 Belgian endives, halved lengthwise and braised or roasted with olive oil, balsamic & lemon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Roast cubed sweet potatoes with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper for 25 minutes.
Mix the cottage cheese, wilted chopped spinach, Parmesan, minced garlic, and pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl.

Cut a horizontal pocket into the thickest side of each chicken breast. Stuff with the spinach-cottage cheese mixture, seal with toothpicks, and season outside with paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.

Sear stuffed chicken breasts and halved Belgian endives in an oven-safe skillet for 3 minutes, then transfer to the 400°F oven for 15–17 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F and endives are caramelized.
